newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha physical bids $3 Up, aug swaps weaker.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha physical bids $3 Up, aug swaps weaker.

text.p: Naphtha traders were Friday seen putting in fresh bids and offers on the NWE physical market that represented yet another dramatic climb in values comparable with gains seen since mid-week.

A London-based trader placed a bid for a July 20/August 5 cargo at $194 CIF NWE, but was unable to reach agreement with another dealer heard offering at $195. The bidder indicated differences remained over price and over cargo specifications.

The newly talked levels were well up on the $191 CIF NWE open spec deal on Thursday, but contrasted with a slight decline in naphtha swaps values for August as September held relatively firm and October values showed some gains.
Friday's reverse in crude futures values was seen knocking back August swap bids by $1 to $189.50 by late afternoon, while $191 was seen to be the unchanged offer level.
September swaps were seen backwardated by $3.50 against August at $187.00-$187.50, while October was valued $1.50 behind September.
